metadata.title: Searching for Magnetar Binaries Disrupted by Core-Collapse Supernovae

notes: No eligible stars: the paper uses “unbound” for companions no longer gravitationally bound to magnetars after core collapse, not for stars explicitly unbound from the Milky Way. It applies no Galactic escape/unbinding criterion and makes no present-day Galactic-unbound claim (see T:p7-b7, T:p7-b9, T:p22-b11).
